title: Summit Ranch Equine Center
specs: Direct private access to Mt. Diablo State Park trails
Indoor arena 180' by 70', groomed twice daily
Outdoor arena 150' by 75', available during dry weather
New apprentice students must be able to saddle and bridle their own horses and pass the level 1 CHA written and riding test
Proof of West Nile, Flu/Rhino, Sleeping Sickness, and Tetanus vaccinations required upon arrival
Apprentices need riding helmet, proper riding boots, jeans or riding pants, lunch and/or snacks
Apprentice program is a group program for youth ages 11-17

Diablo State Park for trail riding. Facilities include indoor and outdoor arenas, round pens, and turnout paddocks.
